title: First Snow
subtitle: Destroy the Concord border post at Varn Ford
briefing: Comrade Commander. In one hour the Iron Pact will do what the cowards in Geneva said we would never dare: we will cross the Varn and take back the lands that were stolen from us in the last war.
Your task is the first blow. A Concord border post watches Varn Ford with a radar dome and a garrison. Destroy the barracks and the radar, and our main columns can cross unseen.
Marshal Volkova herself is watching this operation. Do not disappoint her. Rocket support will join you once you are across the river.
victory_text: Varn Ford is ours. The main columns are crossing.

objectives.text: Destroy the Concord barracks and radar dome at Varn Ford.

lines.speaker: Commissar Lev Orlov
lines.text: The bridge is covered by two pillboxes. Flame troopers will make short work of them. Bears through the gap.

lines.speaker: Commissar Lev Orlov
lines.text: Right-click to move and attack, Comrade. Drag a box to command many at once.

lines.speaker: Marshal Katya Volkova
lines.text: You are across. Good. Rocket support is moving up behind you.

lines.speaker: Concord Radio (intercept)
lines.text: Border Watch to Kessel, we are under attack at Varn Ford! Repeat, under attack! Send everything!

lines.speaker: Commissar Lev Orlov
lines.text: Thunder rocket trucks fire from very far away, but not up close. Keep them behind your tanks.

shots.speaker: Marshal Katya Volkova
shots.text: Commander. Twelve years ago they drew a line across our country and called it peace. Tonight we erase it.

shots.speaker: Marshal Katya Volkova
shots.text: Their border post is blind to what is coming. Keep it that way. Destroy the barracks and the radar dome.

shots.speaker: Commissar Lev Orlov
shots.text: The Premier is listening, Comrade. History is listening. Begin.

shots.speaker: Marshal Katya Volkova
shots.text: The first snow has fallen, Commander. Tonight we march west.

shots.speaker: Commissar Lev Orlov
shots.text: The Premier sends his congratulations. And a reminder, Commander: the word 'Aurora' does not exist. You have never heard it.
